Author: Alian713
Description:
This mod is CBA and CBA Hero, now remastered by Alian713 for DE!! The gameplay is the same as always, but with new QoL features that were added with DE being utilised to their full potential!
Remaster Highlights:
1. Check out the trade workshop in the back of your base, it is now used to control certain aspects of the game like spawn distance instead of needing to move a unit around the map!
2. Exact kill count and age up and razing requirements are displayed on the top right!
3. A new option to walk through a
tutorial
has been added to the map! Yes, you read it right, CBA now offers a
tutorial
for new players!
If you find any bugs, or have re-balancing requests or other suggestions, please reach out to me on discord:
